docs.text:
The Sanskrit text of the tale of Nala and Damayantī with a full vocabulary and Milman's verse translation (Oxford, second edition 1879).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Nalopákhyanam. Story of Nala, an episode of the Mahábhárata. The Sanskrit text, with a copious vocabulary and an improved version of Dean Milman's translation · Monier-Williams, Monier, Sir, 1819-1899, Milman, Henry Hart, 1791-1868 · 1879, 360 scanned pages. Published 1879; Monier Monier-Williams died 1899 and Henry Hart Milman 1868; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
